3334.title: Compact hover opens an unstable drawer
3334.rootCauseOneLine: Fine-pointer hover stays enabled while compact popovers use a pointer-covering drawer, producing open/close/reopen transitions.

prReviews.topFinding: Compact gating addresses the mismatch; keyboard activation needs verification.

3334.proposedFix: Gate hover on compact viewport state and cancel pending hover timers; preserve explicit activation.
3334.caveats: Reduced-style component fixture reproduced three transitions, not endless flicker in the full app. No duplicate fix because #3335 is open.
